title: Gentler SALIENDO pulse
description: EXPLORATORY — refines the SALIENDO row's current hard blink into a slower, shallower opacity pulse (1 -> 0.55 -> 1 over ~2.4s instead of a sharper on/off flash), so the departing state reads as calm attention rather than an alarm. Demonstrated live on row 1 of the mini-board.
warning: app/pages/index.vue deliberately uses a plain re-render, not TransitionGroup, because a promoted SALIENDO row (index 0) FLIP-animating over another row rendered two trips' text in the same space. Do not implement without solving that.

changes.intent: Replace the existing blink keyframe with a gentler, slower opacity pulse for the whole departing row and its dot.
changes.detail: Swap the current pulse animation for one with a shallower opacity floor (~0.55 vs current) and a longer duration (~2.4s vs current), eased in/out rather than stepped. Purely a timing/easing/amplitude change to an existing animation — no structural change to the row itself — but still classified as logic here because it touches the same row that is promoted to index 0 on departure, which is the exact collision described in the warning.
